breaking_news.headline: Aga's restaurant in Houston is number one in the world for Uber Eats deliveries
breaking_news.summary: In Houston, Aga's Indian-Pakistani restaurant serves around 4,000 meals a day and according to Uber Eats, it has the most takeout orders in the world on the their platform.

breaking_news.headline: Everyone is racing to create an AI device. Meta thinks it has one
breaking_news.summary: Tech companies are betting that people will connect with AI using something other than smartphones. Meta is going all-in on glasses, after launching its new AI agent Muse.

breaking_news.headline: Smart-ring maker Oura delays its IPO citing market uncertainty
breaking_news.summary: The leading smart ring manufacturer says the delay is "despite strong demand." It was betting its trove of health data would be a hit with Wall Street.

breaking_news.headline: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
breaking_news.summary: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

breaking_news.headline: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
breaking_news.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

breaking_news.headline: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
breaking_news.summary: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

breaking_news.headline: Democrat Pete Buttigieg criticizes Trump's rollback of fuel-economy standards
breaking_news.summary: The former transportation secretary says weaker fuel-economy standards could raise long-term costs for drivers and leave U.S. automakers further behind China.

breaking_news.headline: How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off)
breaking_news.summary: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

breaking_news.headline: Dutch police arrest suspected member of group that claimed FBI hack
breaking_news.summary: The suspect, 24, was arrested before the alleged cyber attack took place.

breaking_news.headline: First female prime minister named in Morocco after winning elections
breaking_news.summary: Her appointment by the king makes her only the second woman to lead a government in the Arab world.

breaking_news.headline: More than 400 detained as France student protests escalate
breaking_news.summary: Students have been protesting conditions and resources in high schools since last week.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli settlers attack West Bank village and block Palestinian family's return home
breaking_news.summary: Two homes belonging to the al-Tubasi family were set on fire and Israeli security forces were also targeted by settlers.

breaking_news.headline: 'I was lured into a trap': Evan Gershkovich on moment that led to 16 months in Russian jail
breaking_news.summary: The US journalist says he realised he was a "a pawn in a greater game" when he was not interrogated or tortured by FSB agents.

breaking_news.headline: Six Flags shuts down X2 rollercoaster after hundreds allege brain injuries
breaking_news.summary: The announcement comes after multiple lawsuits alleged that hundreds of riders suffered brain injuries from X2, a ride with seats that spin 360 degrees.

breaking_news.headline: South Africa to clean up high-risk areas after 12 women killed
breaking_news.summary: The deaths sparked a national outcry about the scale of violence against women in the country.

breaking_news.headline: Spain announces ban on evictions after protests over 87-year-old woman's removal from flat
breaking_news.summary: The ban is part of a number of proposals that must be approved in parliament within 30 days.

breaking_news.headline: OpenAI agents get rebrand - as 'dots' - while safety worries delay new model
breaking_news.summary: Sam Altman spoke in San Francisco during OpenAI’s yearly event for tech developers.

breaking_news.headline: Soho House venue under investigation for food safety
breaking_news.summary: A former chef contacted Hackney Council after complaining to managers at the members' club.

breaking_news.headline: The start-ups hoping to return battery making to the US
breaking_news.summary: Batteries based on sodium-ion technology could be made in the US with locally sourced materials.

breaking_news.headline: Chinese AI tool told researchers how to make bioweapons
breaking_news.summary: Mindgard said it discovered in July that Kimi models K2.6 and K3 Swarm could evade developer's safety limits.
